messages:
devon: quick question — who can approve this PR? it updates CODEOWNERS and moves a few files under /services/codemap. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/832 :eyes:

maria: pinging eng-platform owners, this touches routing + infra config so we need at least one eng-platform + infra approver. is there an existing CODEOWNERS entry for that path?

sam_k: i looked — current CODEOWNERS has: 
```
# service dirs
/services/*  @platform-arch @service-owners
```
but codemap is nested, and the PR renames folder to /services/codemap-core which no longer matches the wildcard we rely on.

jules: hmm okay. do we want to update CODEOWNERS in this PR to include the new path? that would let platform-arch approve. if we can't get immediate approval, we can request a repo-admin override (rare but possible).

codeowners-bot: Automatic check: APPEARS_UNOWNED -> files under `services/codemap-core/` have no explicit codeowners match. Suggest adding a matching line to CODEOWNERS or adding `@platform-arch` as reviewers.

devon: i'm fine updating CODEOWNERS in the same PR, but wanted to confirm the right owners. so is `@platform-arch @infra` the correct pair? or should i add @service-owners instead of infra?

emily: for this change we need a platform-arch signoff (design for routing) and either service-owners or infra for deployment/infra changes. infra typically owns ops scripts; service-owners own service code. what exactly is changing?

devon: small move + add of a couple of init scripts under codemap-core that touch deployment manifests. nothing heavy. i can add the CODEOWNERS line proposed by sam and tag both teams.

maria: SGTM. if you add the line, request reviews from @platform-arch and @service-owners. that should be enough to merge. leave a clear PR description about the deployment impact so infra can skip if not needed.

sam_k: nit — use the explicit path to avoid future misses: `/services/codemap-core/  @platform-arch @service-owners` (trailing slash ensures dir match).

devon: cool will push an update in a few mins. if anyone from platform-arch sees and can quick-approve after i add owners, that'd be great. otherwise pinging leads: @maria @jules

jules: i can take a look after lunch. if it's small and CODEOWNERS is updated, go ahead and request reviews. :thumbsup:

emily: also adding a note — if you ever need an emergency merge and can't get both approvals, open a ticket in #eng-oncall and request a short owner waiver with a clear rollback path. we've used that twice for infra rollouts.

devon: got it — thanks all. i'll update the PR and mark ready-for-review. :shipit:
